theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.65%) and Communication Svcs (+1.30%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.21%) and Utilities (-0.06%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.27% versus -0.06% for defensives and +0.69% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +1.09%, Dow +1.08%, Nasdaq +1.27% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.67%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 11.49% to 15.79, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.61% to $4,415.00, crude oil was little changed at $99.07, and bitcoin gained 2.76% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
